intro: The Stormwind Army has issued a public bounty on the murloc tribes spreading through eastern Elwynn Forest. With the garrison stretched thin, Guard Thomas relies on traveling adventurers to cull the shoreline encampments around Stone Cairn Lake and the southern waterways before they overrun the region's farms and roads.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn. Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.
The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have the fins? Great! Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.
Your actions have helped realize that.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
